jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV - Sustainability
jobs.description:
### **Position Description:**

The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD).

Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.

The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established BuildLACCD PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances

and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.

* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and

available funding.

* Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
* Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as appropriate.
* Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
* Support compliance with applicable District requirements, BuildLACCD PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

 **Requirements**  

### **Minimum Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field.
* BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong writing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting capital improvement projects within large public works or educational facility construction programs.
* Experience with project cost management, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) development, and funding verification.
* Familiarity with BuildLACCD or similar capital improvement program financial controls, budget management, and project establishment processes.
* Familiarity with Division of the State Architect (DSA) d

jobs.title: Ecommerce Content Coordinator (Website Content & Page Builder)
jobs.description:
**About ORW | 4 Wheel Parts**

ORW | 4 Wheel Parts is a leading retailer of aftermarket parts and accessories for trucks, Jeeps, and SUVs. With retail locations across the country and a growing ecommerce business, we help customers find the products they need to customize and upgrade their vehicles.

**Why Join Us**

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
* Employee discounts on automotive parts and accessories
* Opportunities to learn and grow in ecommerce and digital marketing

**About the role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, entry-level team member to create and maintain customer-facing website pages in Adobe Commerce (Magento). This hands-on role focuses on page creation, content loading, and keeping ecommerce promotions accurate, visually appealing, and easy for customers to use. You will work with approved copy, creative assets, and established templates, following brand standards and publishing approvals.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build and update homepage content, promotional and campaign landing pages, and category pages using Adobe Commerce Page Builder and content management tools.
* Load and format product and category copy, images, banners, promotional messages, calls to action, links, and other digital assets.
* Carry out merchandising updates for promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and sales events using approved direction.
* Update page layouts within established templates, brand guidelines, and content standards; crop or resize supplied images as needed.
* Check desktop and mobile pages for accurate content, clear formatting, working links and buttons, and correct images before publishing.
* Assist with basic search engine optimization (SEO), including page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, and keyword placement, following guidance.
* Coordinate with ecommerce, marketing, merchandising, and creative teams to meet deadlines and obtain required approvals.
* Identify and report content issues, broken links, and formatting inconsistencies. Correct routine content issues and flag technical or template problems for developers.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in digital marketing, web design, communications, or a related field is a plus.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, written communication, and proofreading skills.
* Interest in ecommerce, website content management, digital marketing, or web design.
* Willingness to learn new software, tools, and website publishing processes.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred skills**

* Familiarity with Adobe Commerce (Magento) or another content management system. Basic HTML, CSS, and SEO knowledge is helpful.
* Familiarity with the Adobe suite, including Adobe Photoshop or Adobe Express, or similar image-editing tools.
* Understanding of responsive web design and mobile website layouts.
* Experience updating websites, creating landing pages, or working with ecommerce platforms is a plus.
* Hands-on Adobe Target experience is a plus.

**What success looks like**

Pages and promotional content publish accurately and on schedule, follow brand and SEO guidance, and display properly on desktop and mobile. Banners, links, and calls to action work as intended. You complete updates efficiently with minimal errors and develop proficiency in Adobe Commerce content workflows.

**Additional Information**

**Equal Employment Opportunity & Employment Requirements**

ORW USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. We participate in E-Verify, and employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, in accordance with applicable laws.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Sales Coordinator provides administrative, operational, and sales support to the Sales & Marketing Department for Hyatt House LAX and Hyatt Place LAX.  
This position plays an important role in keeping the sales department organized, ensuring timely follow-up on business opportunities, coordinating client communications, and supporting the sales team in achieving revenue goals for both properties.  
  
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, professional, and comfortable working in a fast-paced hotel environment. This individual will serve as an important link between the sales team, hotel operations, clients, and prospective customers.  
  
**Our Expectations**  
  
We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, demonstrates initiative, and understands that organization and follow-through are essential to a successful hotel sales operation.  
  
This is not simply an administrative position. The Sales Coordinator is an important part of the revenue-generating team and is expected to be proactive, solution-oriented, and committed to helping both Hyatt House LAX and Hyatt Place LAX achieve their business objectives.  
  
Our goal is simple: Stay organized, sell together, follow through, and win business for both hotels.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
1. Sales Administration & Support  
  
* + Provide daily administrative support to the Dual Director of Sales & Marketing and sales team.
  + Prepare sales proposals, contracts, correspondence, presentations, and client documents.
  + Maintain organized electronic sales files and client records.
  + Assist with preparing weekly sales reports, production reports, and department updates.
  + Maintain accurate sales calendars, appointments, and meeting schedules.
  + Assist with expense reports, purchase requests, and departmental paperwork.
  
2. Lead Management & Follow-Up  
  
* + Monitor incoming sales inquiries and distribute leads to the appropriate sales manager.
  + Assist with responding to RFPs, group inquiries, and corporate requests.
  + Maintain accurate lead tracking and follow-up records.
  + Follow up on outstanding proposals and pending contracts as directed.
  + Ensure leads and opportunities are updated in the hotel's sales and CRM systems.
  + Help identify opportunities to generate repeat business.
  
3. Group & Event Coordination  
  
* + Assist with group room blocks, rooming lists, and booking instructions.
  + Prepare group resumes and communicate important details to hotel operations.
  + Coordinate site inspections and client appointments.
  + Assist with organizing client meetings, familiarization tours, and sales events.
  + Ensure all group documentation is accurate and distributed to the appropriate departments.
  
4. Sales & Marketing Coordination  
  
* + Assist with creating sales presentations, marketing materials, and promotional campaigns.
  + Support social media and property marketing initiatives as assigned.
  + Help coordinate client appreciation events and hotel promotions.
  + Maintain updated property information, fact sheets, and sales collateral.
  + Assist with coordinating sales blitzes, prospecting activities, and trade show preparation.
  
5. Communication & Team Support  
  
* + Serve as a communication liaison between the sales department and hotel operations.
  + Participate in daily sales stand-up meetings and weekly department meetings.
  + Help track sales activities, appointments, site visits, and prospecting efforts.
  + Assist with special projects and assignments from the Director of Sales & Marketing.
  + Maintain professionalism and positive communication with clients, colleagues, and hotel leadership.
  
**Qualifications & Experience**  
  
* + Previous hotel experience preferred.
  + Previous administrative or sales coordination experience preferred.
  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  + Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  + Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  + Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  + Familiarity with hotel sales systems, CRM platforms, and property management systems is a plus.
  + Strong attention to detail and a customer-focused attitude.
  + Ability to work independently while supporting a collaborative sales team.
  
**Performance Expectations**  
  
Success in this position will be measured by:  
  
* + Timely response and follow-up on sales inquiries.
  + Accuracy of contracts, proposals, reports, and group documentation.
  + Organization and maintenance of sales files and CRM records.
  + Consistent support of both hotel sales teams.
  + Effective communication with hotel departments.
  + Ability to anticipate departmental needs and take initiative.
  + Contribution to the overall efficiency and productivity of the Sales & Marketing Department.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Hourly Wage**

ISS offers a competitive compensation, with an hourly pay range $25.00 per hour - $28.00 per hour.

**Work Hours**

The work hours for this position are approximately Mon-Fri, 8:30 am - 5:00 pm

**Key Purpose**

The **Administrative Coordinator** – HSEQ provides essential administrative and operational support focused on menu management, recipe administration, food safety, allergen awareness, and quality. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate menu and recipe information within the menu management system and ensuring timely communication of menu and recipe changes to the appropriate teams.

The Administrative Coordinator works closely with culinary, operations, HSEQ, and account leadership teams to support menu and recipe development, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure information is communicated effectively. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, basic culinary knowledge, allergen awareness, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced food service environment.

**Success Criteria**

* Consistently maintains accurate, timely, and high-quality menu and recipe information
* Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
* Maintains strong organization and prioritization while managing multiple menu and recipe updates
* Communicates menu changes and updates clearly and within established timelines
* Demonstrates basic understanding of culinary terminology, ingredients, recipes, and food preparation
* Demonstrates awareness of common food allergens and the importance of accurate allergen information
* Identifies discrepancies or missing information and follows up appropriately
* Actively seeks opportunities to improve menu management processes and team efficiency

**Key Areas of Collaboration and Influence**

* Supports culinary teams with recipe and menu development administration
* Collaborates with HSEQ/Quality and operational teams on food safety, allergen, and quality information
* Supports account leadership with menu-related reporting, documentation, and coordination
* Communicates menu and recipe changes between culinary, operational, and support teams
* Serves as a point of coordination for menu management and recipe-related information
* Communicates clearly and professionally with internal stakeholders

**Ideal Candidate Experience**

* High School diploma or equivalent education
* Previous administrative, hospitality, culinary, food service, or service-based experience preferred
* Basic knowledge of culinary terminology, ingredients, recipes, and food preparation
* Basic understanding of food allergens and food safety considerations
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, shifting priorities, and deadlines effectively
* Comfortable working with computer systems, spreadsheets, databases, and menu management software
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Professional, dependable, and service-oriented
* Ability to ask questions, identify discrepancies, and follow through to resolution

**Key Accountabilities**

* Maintain accurate and current menu and recipe information within the designated menu management system
* Enter, update, and review menu items, recipes, ingredients, and related information
* Support culinary teams with the administrative coordination of new recipes, menu items, revisions, substitutions, and seasonal changes
* Ensure recipe and menu information is complete, accurate, and properly documented
* Coordinate with culinary teams to obtain missing information and clarify discrepancies
* Support the review and documentation of allergen and ingredient information, escalating questions to the appropriate culinary or HSEQ resource
* Communicate approved menu and recipe changes to appropriate operational and support teams
* Maintain accurate records, trackers, and documentation related to menu and recipe changes
* Assist with menu and recipe audits to identify outdated, incomplete, or inconsistent information
* Prepare reports and summaries related to menu updates, recipe development, and outstanding items as requested
* Assist with HSEQ, quality, and compliance documentation and data requests as needed
* Support continuous improvement efforts related to menu management, data accuracy, and communication
* Perform general administrative duties and special projects in support of culinary, HSEQ, and account operations

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Frequent use of computer systems, spreadsheets, databases, and menu management software
* Occasional standing, walking, and interaction with culinary and operational teams
* May occasionally work in or visit food service or kitchen environments
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time

**HSEQ Compliance:** All employees must adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality (HSEQ) policies and procedures to ensure a safe and compliant work environment. This includes following safety protocols, maintaining environmental responsibility, and upholding quality standards in all tasks. Employees are expected to actively participate in HSEQ training and report any potential hazards or compliance concerns.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**

The Los Angeles Football Club (LAFC) is an MLS soccer club serving the greater Los Angeles area. LAFC is dedicated to building a world-class soccer club that represents the diversity of Los Angeles and is committed to delivering an unrivaled experience for fans. LAFC's ownership group is comprised of local leaders and innovators of industry with intellectual capital, financial prowess, operations expertise, and success in the fields of entertainment, sports, technology, and media. LAFC is invested in the world's game and Los Angeles, constructing, and developing the 22,000 seat BMO Stadium and a top-flight training center on the campus of Cal-State Los Angeles.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Event Coordinator will assist in organizing, coordinating, and providing support to each applicable department to ensure safe and seamless execution of all events, inclusive of private, concerts, and sporting events, at BMO Stadium.

This role reports to the Event Manager.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Assist Event Managers with proper execution of sporting events, private and internal events, and concerts, while facilitating effective interdepartmental communication and organization across applicable departments in a timely manner.
* Oversee and communicate any changes regarding the 30-day events calendar, meeting agendas, and other event-related administrative functions, ensuring accurate and timely information is shared across all relevant departments..
* Assist in the management and scheduling of part-time match operations staff
* Serve as the event day point of contact for part-time match operations staff during all LAFC, LAFC 2, and other major sporting events at the stadium.
* Assist in locker room and back of house set ups for all sporting events that take place at BMO Stadium.
* Oversee set-up and event management for LAFC 2 matches at Rawlinson Stadium, Titan Stadium, and throughout the Southern California area.
* Assist Events department with daily operations, administrative support, and other special projects.
* Maintain a strong understanding of Guest Experience programs, Security protocols, and Operations procedures while collaborating cross-functionally with internal departments to uphold and exceed stadium standards.
* In partnership with Event Managers, help create production and event notes that clearly communicate all event requirements and drive the goals and objectives of each assigned event.
* Partner with stadium departments to prepare event plans and execute with external clients for each assigned event.
* Manage event budgets and settlements for private and internal events, ensuring expenses remain within budgetary parameters.
* Maintain event folders organized with event notes, budgets, actuals and other event related items.
* Cross train as necessary for all events taking place at BMO Stadium, inclusive of concerts, private and internal events, LAFC, and Angel City FC, and other sporting matches.
* Other duties as assigned by Supervisor/Management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited College/University required.
* Minimum of 1-2 years' experience in an event related position within the sports/entertainment industry required.
* Ability to work productively and multi-task in an unstructured environment with frequent interruptions.
* Strong understanding of event operations, event logistics and venue management.
* Detail-oriented, driven self-motivator with a strong work ethic to get the job done.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential information.
* Possess a positive and optimistic attitude to lead and inspire other departments.
* Ability to communicate effectively and efficiently in English - both verbal and written.
* Working knowledge of Google Workspace programs.
* Flexible work schedule with the ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as the event calendar requires.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.

**SALARY RANGE**

At LAFC, we carefully consider a wide range of factors to determine a fair and equitable compensation package. The final offer amount will consider a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience and training. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure guidelines, the compensation for this role is $24.00 per hour.

**HIRING PRACTICES**

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

LAFC strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law.

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator - Entry-Level
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an organised and enthusiastic Event Coordinator to support the planning and delivery of events in Culver City, California.

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, keeping things organised and seeing projects come together. You’ll help coordinate event preparations, communicate with vendors and attendees, and support the team in making sure each event runs smoothly.

Previous event planning experience is welcome but not essential. A positive attitude, attention to detail and willingness to learn are important.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assist with planning and coordinating events, meetings and other scheduled activities.
* Help arrange venues, equipment, supplies and event materials.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager, Trade Shows & Sponsorships - Retail
jobs.description:
**TITLE:** Event Marketing Manager, Trade Shows & Sponsorships - Retail

**REPORTS TO:** Experiential Marketing Manager

**LOCATION:** Brooklyn, NY — OR — Marina del Rey, CA (Onsite Monday - Friday)

**Who is Flip?**

There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one-of-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country.

The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling-and-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B+ TAMs each, and we're still early.

We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true.

**What You'll Own**

Events are one of the biggest ways we grow across the three industries we serve — retail, healthcare, and transportation. From major trade shows and conferences to client experiences (Flippin' Legends), brand activations, and internal company events, you'll own Flip's event presence end to end.

You know the B2B trade show world inside and out, love planning the work and working the plan, and hold everyone around you to the same standard. Our creative and content teams bring the ideas — your job is to execute them exceptionally. Not just done, but done right, on time, and on budget.

**Core Day-to-Day**

* Trade shows & conferences. Own Flip's presence end to end. Identify the right events across retail, healthcare, and transportation, negotiate sponsorships and booth packages, manage all logistics, and ensure Flip shows up in a way that turns heads and drives pipeline. Retail industry trade show experience is a strong plus.
* Pre-event planning. Build detailed event plans and timelines well in advance. Coordinate across sales, marketing, and leadership to align on goals, messaging, and on-site experience. Manage all vendor relationships, contracts, and deadlines.
* Budget management & ROI. Own event budgets from estimate through reconciliation, delivering maximum impact within a reasonable spend. Track and report ROI for every event — leads generated, pipeline influenced, brand impressions, follow-up conversion — and use that data to prioritize the events that deliver.
* On-site execution & team leadership. Lead the team on the ground at every event. Manage setup, staffing, scheduling, and real-time problem solving. Ensure every detail is executed to plan and the Flip team is set up to have meaningful conversations and capture every lead.
* Post-event follow-through. Debrief the team, report results, coordinate with sales on lead follow-up, and document learnings. Every event should make the next one better.
* Brand activations, swag & content. Partner with creative and content to bring activations to life; source and track event merchandise and collateral; coordinate photo, video, and client interview capture for social and post-event promotion.
* Internal events. Plan and coordinate events for the Flip team — company meetings, offsites, industry parties, and client dinners.

**What We're Looking For - Must-haves**

* 3+ years managing B2B trade shows and industry conferences, with end-to-end ownership of logistics, sponsorships, and on-site execution.
* Retail industry familiarity is a strong plus — you know its major trade shows and how buyers show up at them.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills — multiple events and deadlines at once, without dropping a detail.
* Proven budget ownership and ROI fluency. You've built and managed event budgets, negotiated with vendors and organizers, and used performance data to inform future strategy.
* Strong leadership on the ground — comfortable directing teams and vendors in a fast-paced environment, and holding partners accountable without losing the relationship.
* A natural collaborator who translates creative and content teams' ideas into flawless execution.
* Relentless attention to detail. You love a checklist, own every open item, and don't stop until everything is closed out.
* Adaptable and calm under pressure. If you're a chaos-wrangler who brings order to complexity, we want to meet you.

### **More About Us**

* We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada
* We've raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data
* Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year
* In office 5 days/week

  

#FlippinLegend

Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

jobs.title: Film Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Luminate is the entertainment industry's preeminent data and insights partner, serving as the single source of truth for record labels, film studios, talent agencies, and every part of the music and entertainment ecosystem. By aggregating data from over 500 verified sources, Luminate provides customers with the objective validation needed to make critical business decisions and track global market share. While its data famously fuels the Billboard Charts and the Variety Streaming Originals Charts, Luminate's primary mission is to empower the entertainment industry with essential, accurate and objective data.

**Luminate Film & TV** (Luminate F&TV) is the leading entertainment data solution that provides verified, timely, and accurate metadata around people, projects, and companies that work in the global entertainment business.  
  
The **Film Research Coordinator** will work closely with the Senior Director of Film Research and other colleagues to ensure the metadata for all film projects is complete and accurate in the Luminate F&TV database.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Gathering and entering various data points for feature film and streaming project records
* Conducting direct outreach to studios and production companies to confirm forward-looking information and other metadata for film and streaming content
* Tracking daily trades and breaking entertainment news
* Assisting with data scrub initiatives based on direction from the Senior Director
* Researching and adding Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) data to talent records as required for accurate representation across our website
* Contributing to quality assurance (QA) for the implementation of website enhancements.
* Supporting Luminate Film & TV's collaboration with its clients and data partners

  

**Qualifications:**

* At least 1+ year of full-time experience in the entertainment industry (experience working at a major studio/network/production company/agency preferred).
* Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Must be able to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Must have a strong technical aptitude and a working knowledge of software applications, especially spreadsheets
* Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative team attitude
* A strong passion for the entertainment industry

  

**As Luminate values in-person collaboration and team cohesion, employees work onsite 4 days a week and 1 day remotely with a focus on maintaining a vibrant and inclusive culture.**

Additionally, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

  

**For candidates based in California:** A good faith estimate of the salary range is $25/hr. upon hire. We consider your skills and experience, what similar jobs pay at companies of our size, and ensure fair pay among colleagues. Final base salary offer amounts are determined by factors including your experience and expertise. In addition we are proud to offer additional perks and benefits that contribute and complete our total compensation package. Luminate reserves the right to change our compensation bands at any time.

**It's all About You…**

As a part of PMC's family of companies, Luminate's comprehensive benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support every aspect of your life, empowering you to thrive both personally and professionally. **We offer Company-Paid Healthcare Premiums with no employee paycheck contributions on medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family.** Luminate also offers Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care & Commuter), an Employee Assistance Program, Life Insurance, Short & Long Term Disability, Paid Parental Leave, and a 401(k) Retirement Plan with an Employer match. Employees are also eligible to take advantage of company discounts and perks including Pet Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Mortgage discounts, and a variety of other savings on wellness, lifestyle, and financial essentials. **As part of Luminate dedication to consistently meet employee's needs, we maintain a Flexible Vacation Policy.**

At Luminate, we believe working in a highly collaborative, office-first environment that fosters real-time communication, spontaneous idea sharing, and stronger interpersonal relationships that drive innovation and team cohesion.

**More About Us:** Luminate has incredible 30 year history that has made us who we are today. We power the Billboard Charts, but we also inform the entire music industry with exclusive research, data and insights. We serve the television and film industry, providing deep meta-data on every major production and title.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Merchandise Coordinator – Apparel Buying

**About Us:**

Stately (www.statelymen.com) is a leading men’s personal styling subscription service dedicated to delivering curated clothing experiences that elevate our customers’ style and confidence. We’re a fast-growing, innovative company committed to redefining how men shop for and wear clothing.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an organized and **detail-oriented** Merchandise Coordinator to join our dynamic men’s apparel buying team. This role supports the buying office in ensuring the smooth execution of merchandising strategies and operational tasks. As a Merchandise Coordinator, you will collaborate closely with buyers, vendors, and operations to assist in order management. This is a hybrid position with remote work from home 2-3 days per week and 1-2 days per week from our Fullerton/Greater Los Angeles, California office

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Order Management:** Support the buying team in creating and managing purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in product details, pricing, and delivery timelines.
* **Accounts Payable**: Key point person to review, validate, and partner with Accounting to approve incoming invoices prior to payments being processed.
* **Data Management:** Enter and update product information in merchandising systems, ensuring all data is accurate and up-to-date for assortment plans, pricing, and inventory tracking and management.
* **Sample Coordination:** Track, organize, and manage product samples for meetings, photo shoots, and seasonal line reviews.
* **Vendor Communication:** Assist with sample requests, tracking, follow-ups, and resolving issues related to purchase orders, deliveries, or product information.
* **Reporting:** Generate weekly sales and inventory reports to track product performance and identify trends or opportunities for improvement.
* **Meeting Preparation:** Prepare materials and supplies for internal and vendor meetings.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in a retail buying office or merchandising role is required. Operational experience is a plus but not required.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel/G-Suite Tools (e.g. Google Sheets)
* Familiarity in AI-Assisted Tools (e.g. Claude, Chat GTP)
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to autonomously keep track of various deadlines from multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with an emphasis on attention to detail and can work independently.
* Reliable transportation to get to our Fullerton office 1-2 times a week.

**Compensation:** Starting at $30/hour; pay negotiable based on experience.

**Why Join Stately:**

* Shape the future of modern menswear. Join one of the fastest-growing men’s personal styling brands disrupting how men discover and wear great clothes.
* Own more than just buying. Your decisions will directly influence our marketing, styling, operations, and member experience—driving growth across the entire business.
* Move fast, make an impact. We’re a lean, ambitious team where great ideas don’t get buried in layers of approval—they get implemented.
* Build something that matters. Help scale a brand trusted by tens of thousands of men nationwide and play a defining role in its next stage of growth.
* Competitive pay, benefits, and real upside. As we grow, so will your influence, opportunity, and career trajectory.

**How to Apply:**

If you’re passionate about building brand partnerships, discovering the next great menswear brands, and driving growth through smart, strategic buying—we want to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.

**Equal Opportunity:** Stately is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**At-Will Employment:** Employment with Stately is at-will and may be terminated by either the employee or the company at any time, with or without cause or notice, as permitted by law.

Pay: $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of work experience do you have with Microsoft Excel/ Google Suite?
* Can you work in-office from our Fullerton/Los Angeles, CA office 1-2 days per week?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fullerton, CA 92831

jobs.description:
***About PS***  
PS is redefining the way the world travels. We build and operate private airport terminals that transform commercial air travel into a seamless luxury experience. Currently serving guests at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL), Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW), and Miami International Airport (MIA), with Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) coming soon. PS is pioneering a new global standard in hospitality.

Far from the crowds and chaos of the public airport, PS offers members the privacy, ease, and security of the private flight experience while flying commercial. With exclusive partnerships with TSA and U.S. Customs and Border Protection, guests move effortlessly through line-free departures and arrivals. Every moment is carefully orchestrated by our expert team - private TSA screening, dedicated customs and immigration services, and luxury chauffeur transfers across the airfield directly to or from your aircraft.

Inside our private terminals, guests enjoy serene suites, chef-prepared dining, spa services, and personalized attention, while our Control Room coordinates discreetly with government, airline, and security partners to ensure unmatched efficiency, safety, and peace of mind. At PS, waiting in lines, crowded terminals, and luggage hassles give way to quiet elegance, service with heart and inspired experiences.

We are building more than terminals - we are shaping a new way to travel. If you’re passionate about luxury hospitality and excited to be part of something extraordinary, join us as we expand to new markets and reimagine the future of travel with PS.

**Position: Jr. Account Coordinator**

The Jr. Account Coordinator plays a foundational role in supporting the Sales and Membership team, ensuring both the operational excellence and high-touch service required to deliver a seamless experience for ultra–high-net-worth guests and members. This role blends administrative precision with client-facing exposure, supporting internal membership onboarding and renewal, account support, and reporting and data collection. The account coordinator is responsible for supporting members with diligence and discretion. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and service-minded, with a strong interest in improving processes and delivering exceptional service. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in account management, gain exposure to UHNW client engagement, and grow within a category-defining global hospitality brand.

This role reports to the Director of Member Engagement.

**Responsibilities & Expectations**

* Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs of the Sales and Membership team, including billing, reporting, account support and special projects
* Execute a high volume of internal account onboarding of new members
* Assist members as needed with account support, questions, and guidance
* Support special project management and execution
* Serve as a key point of coordination for client interactions, ensuring a seamless, highly personalized experience aligned with luxury service standards
* Correspond with UHNW members, travel advisors, and partners via phone and email in a polished, professional, and discreet manner
* Maintain rigorous accuracy within Salesforce and Stripe, including reporting and membership tracking

**Requirements**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with UHNW clientele
* Highly detail-oriented and organized, with a strong sense of ownership over administrative execution and follow-through
* Strong operational discipline with a commitment to data accuracy, CRM hygiene, and process consistency
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining precision in a fast-paced, high-touch environment
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, paired with sound judgment and discretion
* Proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems, and drive tasks to completion independently
* Comfortable balancing client-facing responsibilities with behind-the-scenes operational execution
* Proficiency with AI tools and a demonstrated ability to leverage them to streamline workflows and maximize productivity
* Adaptable and flexible as priorities evolve

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2 years + experience with UHNWI B2C
* Experience working around confidential and sensitive information
* Experience with Stripe and Salesforce
* Finance or Customer Service experience

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

* Employee benefits include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, long-term and short-term disability
* 401K retirement plan with company matching
* Health and Dependent care FSA and HSA with company matching
* Merit-based raises and bonuses
* 12 PTO Days / 6 Paid Sick Days Prorated Annually
* Monthly health & wellness and phone reimbursement
* Paid training
* A great career path with promotion opportunities.

**Location:** Hybrid, based in one of our terminal markets (Los Angeles, CA; Dallas, TX; Atlanta, GA or Miami, FL)

***The compensation range for this position is $31.25-$36.00/hour. Overtime opportunities available. This is a full-time role.***

jobs.description:

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

**TECHNICAL ACCOUNT MANAGER**

SpaceXSI was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceXSI is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

Our terrestrial compute infrastructure team delivers high-performance GPU/CPU clusters and related systems to support demanding customer workloads. We are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) / Solutions Architect (Technical Lead) to own the technical success of these deployments. In this role, you will lead technical implementation, integration, and optimization across all customer accounts, ensuring reliable, high-performance compute environments from initial provisioning through steady-state operations.

This role is part of a high-velocity team with extremely high expectations. You will apply deep technical expertise to drive customer outcomes in a fast-paced, autonomously driven, and demanding atmosphere. This role offers the opportunity to drive cutting-edge terrestrial compute infrastructure that powers next-generation AI capabilities for a key strategic partner. If you thrive on ownership and technical excellence, we encourage you to apply.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Apply expertise to large-scale compute system development, including design validation, integration, performance tuning, and optimization
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for compute infrastructure definition, requirements, and delivery across all customer accounts

* Ensure on-time deliverables, proactive risk mitigation, and overall mission success for all customers

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or other technical discipline
* 7+ years of hands-on professional experience in large-scale compute, data center, or hyperscale infrastructure environments
* Experience leading technical implementations involving GPUs/CPUs and high-performance systems

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Master's degree or higher in a STEM discipline
* Prior experience as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, or equivalent supporting enterprise or hyperscale compute deployments
* Deep knowledge of InfiniBand, RoCE, NVIDIA networking technologies (NCCL, NVLink, GPU Direct RDMA), and large GPU cluster architectures
* Experience with AI/ML training and inference infrastructure at scale
* Strong background in performance tuning, security/compliance implementation, and hybrid/cloud integration
* Demonstrated ability to assess risk and make decisions with incomplete data in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interface effectively with customers and internal stakeholders
* Hands-on experience with Linux environments, orchestration tools, and infrastructure monitoring

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed during critical implementation, testing, and incident response periods
* Willingness to travel (up to 25%) to data center sites and customer locations
* Must be comfortable operating with extreme ownership in a demanding, high-expectation environment

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
**TITLE:** Client Success Manager  
**REPORTING TO:** Client Success Lead  
**LOCATION:** Brooklyn, NY - OR - Marina del Rey, CA

### **Who Is Flip?**

There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one-of-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country.

The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling-and-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B+ TAMs each, and we're still early.

We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true.

### **What You'll Do**

As a Client Success Manager, you'll work directly with our clients to make sure they are getting measurable value from Flip every day. You'll help launch new customers, support and optimize existing accounts, troubleshoot issues, and become a trusted expert on how our product works within their business.

We are hiring across both our Healthcare and eCommerce/Retail verticals.

* Help customers launch successfully — partner with Sales and Client Success to move customers from signed contract through implementation and go-live.
* Become a product expert quickly — master Flip's platform and understand the workflows, configurations, and integrations that power our customers' experiences.
* Own day-to-day client relationships — serve as a reliable point of contact for customer questions, requests, troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization.
* Make the extra test call — proactively test experiences, investigate issues, identify edge cases, and make sure what we deliver actually works for the customer.
* Dig beyond the initial request — learn to understand the "why" behind customer questions and identify the underlying problem they are trying to solve.
* Configure and optimize Flip — make changes within the platform and help customers continuously improve their voice and text experiences.
* Work alongside Product and Engineering — clearly document bugs, feature requests, and customer feedback so internal teams can quickly understand and act on them.
* Use data to understand performance — monitor customer metrics, identify trends, and help communicate the impact Flip is having on their business.
* Build incredible customer relationships — be responsive, organized, thoughtful, and someone our customers genuinely enjoy working with.
* Grow into greater account ownership — develop the technical, strategic, and commercial skills needed to independently manage increasingly complex and enterprise-level customers.

### **What You Bring**

* 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation, Technical Support, Solutions, Account Management, or another client-facing role, ideally within a SaaS or technology company
* Comfortable working directly with B2B clients and managing multiple priorities at once
* Technically curious — you don't need to be an engineer, but you should want to understand how software, integrations, APIs, and data work
* Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to dig into an issue rather than immediately escalate it
* Comfortable working with data and using metrics to understand performance
* Extremely organized and detail-oriented — you follow through, close loops, and don't let client requests disappear
* High aptitude and agency — you learn quickly, take ownership, and use AI and other tools to get to outcomes faster

### **More About Us**

* We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada
* We've raised $30M+ to date, including our recent $20M Series A — backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point, and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data
* This role can sit within either our Retail or Healthcare vertical, which will be determined at offer stage, both teams follow the same interview loop
* Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4 and a full week off at the end of the year
* In office 5 days/week

Invisible Narratives, the first-of-its-kind tra-digital studio, is looking for a Community Manager to help scale a fast-growing slate of creator-led IP. This is a hands-on, front-facing role embedded in the heart of fandoms, creator networks, and YouTube ecosystems — with an equal focus on engagement, creator support, and operational oversight.

**Who We’re Looking For**

You’re part community lead, part YouTube strategist, part brand steward. You’ve worked at an indie game studio, animation collective, or startup where creators, fans, and channels were part of a single living ecosystem. You’re comfortable being a visible voice for the brand — hosting AMAs, answering lore questions, and managing creator relationships — but you also know how to use the backend: CMS, metadata, analytics, and compliance workflows.

You’ll work across fan communities, creator networks, and YouTube channels — helping grow engagement, enforce best practices, and translate insights into action. This isn’t a community job in name only — you’ll be at the center of how our IP lives, evolves, and scales.

**What You’ll Do**

* Actively engage across Discord, YouTube, X, Reddit, and other community platforms

* Collaborate with the marketing and content teams on YouTube rollouts and go-to-market strategies
* Manage YouTube CMS tasks, including metadata updates, channel structure, playlisting, and end-screen/post optimization
* Monitor compliance and brand alignment across partner channels — ensuring creators follow usage guidelines, brand safety requirements, and content obligations
* Track and report analytics from both fan communities and YouTube channels, surfacing trends, feedback, and red flags
* Coordinate with external agencies and internal teams to align messaging and strategy
* Contribute to content planning, surprise community drops, and fan-facing events

**What You Need**

* 2–4 years experience in community management, YouTube operations, or digital marketing
* Strong working knowledge of YouTube CMS, channel structure, metadata optimization, and platform policies
* Experience working with creator networks or digital IP (animation, gaming, or UGC platforms preferred)
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to manage both fan expectations and creator relationships
* Familiarity with Discord, Reddit, and social ecosystems where fan and creator communities thrive
* Excellent written communication and real-time engagement instincts
* Proficiency in basic analytics/reporting tools (YouTube Studio, Discord admin, or social dashboards)

You’ll be the connective tissue between the studio, creators, and fans — helping us build something bigger than just a show or a game. If you’ve lived in the trenches of internet fandoms and creator platforms, we want you in ours.

jobs.description:
**Inventory & Logistics Coordinator**

Gardena, CA

OPEN Healthcare is an advanced laboratory committed to enhancing the quality of life for our patients. Our laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art technology, aiming to deliver sustained quality of services. At OPEN Healthcare, we provide high-quality, reliable, and affordable laboratory and diagnostic services, ensuring accurate and rapid test results. Our extensive test menu designed to meet your health and wellness needs. OPEN Healthcare specializes in esoteric clinical tests including allergy, molecular testing, and other custom assays with mass spectrometry. Learn more aboutOPEN Healthcare at www.ohcus.com.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and takes pride in accurate records and reliable follow-through. As our Inventory & Logistics Coordinator, you will play a key role in keeping our laboratory and collection sites fully stocked by managing inventory in Fishbowl and Excel, preparing supplies and requisitions, and making sure the right materials are in the right place on time.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage laboratory and phlebotomy supply inventory in Fishbowl and Excel, keeping accurate, up-to-date records of all items received, issued and transferred
* Prepare, pack and fulfill supply requisitions and orders for departments, collection sites and clients, verifying quantities and meeting turnaround standards
* Receive, inspect, unpack and store incoming shipments; reconcile against purchase orders and packing slips and report any discrepancies
* Perform regular cycle counts and monthly inventory reconciliations; investigate and resolve variances and support inventory valuation reporting
* Monitor stock levels and reorder points; prepare purchase requests and coordinate with vendors to prevent shortages and manage expiration dates
* Communicate proactively with your supervisor, laboratory staff and client services about supply status, delays and backorders, escalating issues early
* Maintain clean, organized and safe storage areas in line with laboratory safety and handling protocols
* Print, stock and distribute requisition forms and other laboratory documents as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned. All employees may be asked to take on additional projects or responsibilities outside of this document, including but not limited to covering for colleagues or handling unexpected tasks, as business needs require.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics or business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in inventory control, warehouse/supply or logistics (laboratory or healthcare setting a plus)
* Proven experience with inventory management software (Fishbowl or similar) and Microsoft Excel (formulas, lookups, sorting and filtering)
* Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accurate record keeping
* Excellent organization and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including keeping supervisors and teammates informed of delays or issues
* Ability to lift up to 30 pounds and perform repeated bending and lifting, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and evolving work environment
* Must be able to work on-site in our Gardena laboratory/office

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience working in a laboratory, clinical or healthcare environment
* Knowledge of laboratory and phlebotomy supplies and familiarity with common vendors
* IATA / DOT training for shipping biological specimens and supplies
* Experience with purchase orders and vendor coordination
* Experience with document management systems

**SCHEDULE**

* 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday (exact hours to be confirmed with the hiring manager)
* Occasional schedule flexibility may be required to support laboratory operations and supply deadlines.

**PERKS & BENEFITS**

* Health, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with up to 4% matching
* Paid vacation and sick time-off
* Paid holidays
* Flexible spending account
* Discounts offered by ADP

OPEN Healthcare offers a competitive salary and benefits package. The reasonable estimated salary for this role ranges from **$24.00 to $27.00 per hour.** Actual compensation is based upon factors such as the candidate's education, skills, qualifications, related work experience, and etc.

OPEN Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. OPEN Healthcare prohibits discrimination on any basis protected under federal, state, or local law, regulation, or ordinance or company policies. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications and business need.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Douglas Adams once said, **"Technology is a word that describes something that doesn't work yet."** Funny, because it's true. So much so that it sparked our unrelenting mission to increase the positive impact of technology on people's lives.

From robot vacuums and voice assistants to banking apps, smart toys, and backyard grills, Centercode has helped shape countless products in virtually every household, and chances are good we've impacted your life already. We're full of people who take pride in striving toward our goals and having a blast while doing it. We're always on the lookout for enthusiastic, like-minded people to join us in making everyday life better through technology.

As a **Strategic Account Manager**, you'll own some of our largest and longest-standing customer relationships, including enterprise product teams at consumer electronics and technology companies, each worth $100,000 to $250,000 a year. While a Renewals Account Manager focuses on our more predictable renewal book, you'll own our more complex enterprise relationships and mid-market accounts through renewal and expansion. Your job is to keep them, grow them, and make them less dependent on any one person, including you. You'll know each account's org chart, product calendar, and what's at stake in their next launch, and you'll be the reason they renew. You'll also help improve our account practices so relationships, plans, and customer knowledge are shared across the team.

**What you'll get:** a focused book of well-known brands, a seat in the conversation as we bring UserVolley, our AI-era product validation platform, to our existing customers, and direct access to our executives.

**What you'll do as a Strategic Account Manager**

*Own the relationship*

* Own 8-12 enterprise accounts and 15-20 mid-market accounts, about $3M in annual recurring revenue
* Take over accounts from prior owners without losing momentum
* Build relationships with the day-to-day program owners, their managers, the budget holders, and procurement
* Know each customer's product roadmap and launch calendar as well as they do
* Recognize and act on events that create urgency (a new product leader, a rough launch, a reorg)
* When a champion leaves, find their successor and rebuild the relationship before renewal
* Represent the customer's voice to Product and Marketing

*Renewals*

* Run each renewal on our 120-day plan so procurement never becomes a surprise
* Negotiate terms, timing, and multi-year agreements with customer stakeholders, backed by RevOps and Finance
* Flag risk early and lead the save plan with Services and Support
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately

*Expansion*

* Initiate conversations with new teams, leaders, and product groups inside your accounts
* Develop relevant needs into qualified expansion opportunities
* Introduce the right Centercode product where it addresses a clear customer need
* Work with Product and a Solutions Consultant to validate fit and adoption or migration path
* Build the business case your champion needs to win budget internally

*Account planning and rhythm*

* Write and keep a living account plan for every account: stakeholder map, renewal path, expansion thesis, and risks
* Run executive business reviews that show outcomes their leadership cares about
* Keep every account, contact, and opportunity current in HubSpot the same day something changes
* Own retention and net growth in your assigned book
* Review risks and expansion progress regularly and measure outcomes over the agreed renewal periods
* Partner with our GM as executive sponsor on top accounts

*Scale yourself*

* Put AI agents to work on account research, meeting prep, and follow-ups, reviewing what they produce
* Build and share practical account workflows and practices the whole team can use
* Maintain clear stakeholder maps and records so any teammate can step in with confidence

**What you need** **to do the job**

*Experience and skills*

* Experience owning renewals and expansion for complex B2B technology accounts
* Direct commercial responsibility for enterprise relationships of $100K+ in annual value
* Named logos you've kept and grown, with the numbers to back it up (gross and net retention by year)
* Proficiency leading renewals and expansions through procurement, legal, and security review at large companies
* Comfort in executive conversations with directors and VPs of product, quality, research, or CX
* Proven ability to craft and present compelling account plans and business cases, on paper and in the room
* Hands-on AI skills for account research, stakeholder mapping, preparation, and follow-up, with output you can verify and explain

*Mindsets and traits*

* Invested in the whole account, not just your main contact
* Calm under pressure when a renewal goes sideways
* Curious about the customer's business and how their products ship
* Organized and forecast-honest, avoiding surprises at quarter end
* Resourceful and proactive when there's no detailed playbook
* Generous with relationships, customer knowledge, and credit

**What'll give you an edge**

* Experience with consumer electronics, connected hardware, or big tech customers
* Background in beta testing, user research, QA, or product management tooling
* You've taken over a book of accounts from someone else without losing any
* Experience introducing a new product to an existing customer base
* Familiarity with a structured framework such as MEDDICC for expansion deals
* Experience introducing new account practices or rebuilding a relationship while customer needs and the product were changing

**The nitty-gritty**

* Compensation: $115k - $130k base + commission ($165k - $185k OTE), with accelerators above plan
* This is a full-time, hybrid position
* Candidate must live within commuting distance of our HQ office (Mission Viejo, California)
* Candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 20% for on-site customer visits
* Sorry, recruite

jobs.title: SFILEN & SFRRN Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Position Summary:**

The Program Coordinator supports the San Francisco Immigrant Legal and Education Network (SFILEN) and the San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) by coordinating partners on grant and contract administration, meetings, and network-wide programming. The Program Coordinator occasionally fills shifts on the SFRRN Hotline, coordinates logistics and develops content and materials for reports, events, campaigns, and social media.

### 

### **About Chinese for Affirmative Action (CAA)**

CAA was founded in 1969 to protect the civil and political rights of Chinese Americans and to advance multiracial democracy in the United States. Today, CAA is a progressive voice in and on behalf of the broader Asian American and Pacific Islander community. CAA advocates for systemic change that protects immigrant rights, promotes language diversity, and remedies racial and social injustice.

### 

### **About SFILEN and SFFRN**

The San Francisco Immigrant Legal and Education Network (SFILEN) and the San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN), are two leading immigration legal service networks in the City. Since their founding in 2006 and 2008 respectively, both networks have paved the way as successful models for multi-ethnic, multi-lingual, multi-strategy coalition building to advance immigrant rights and immigrant access to legal services.

  

The San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) is a 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, immigration enforcement response hotline serving the City of San Francisco. Founded in 2008, and revamped in 2016, SFRRN was one of the first, and remains one of the few 24/7 immigration enforcement response hotlines in the country. SFRRN houses 8 immigration focused community based organizations who staff the 24/7 hotline, verifies immigration enforcement activity in San Francisco, connects San Franciscans to legal and accompaniment services, and provides immigration centered Know-Your-Rights to immigrant community members citywide.

  

In 2026, CAA became the lead and fiscal agency to house SFILEN and SFRRN. As a founding and active member of these networks, CAA is committed to the health and wellbeing of both collaboratives in order that partners may continue to serve immigrant communities with immigration legal services and community education in the face of heightened immigration enforcement and rising xenophobia.

  

### **Position Description**

Program Coordinator coordinates partners in both SFRRN and SFILEN in relation to administration of grants and contracts and network wide programing including regularly scheduled meetings, special events, and campaigns. The Program Coordinator also coordinates logistics, and develops content and materials to support the advancement of SFILEN and SFRRN including for reports, events, campaigns, and meetings. The Coordinator works to ensure alignment and accessibility of information for all network partners and relevant stakeholders. The Program Coordinator will also assist the SFRRN Manager in supporting hotline services including receiving hotline calls, conducting follow-up, and coordinating with partners to respond to incidents of immigration enforcement.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Administrative Support for SFRRN & SFILEN Grants and Contracts*

* Communicate regularly with partners in Spanish and English about administrative requirements, reporting, and deadlines associated with funder compliance.
* Support grant and contract management through monthly data entry, compilation of partner reports, and tracking of services rendered by partners.
* Work closely with the SFILEN and SFRRN Program Managers and the AACRE Capacity Team to ensure timely reporting, invoicing, and submission of funder-required documents across all funding sources.
* Take notes at SFILEN and SFRRN meetings, conduct post-meeting follow-up, and share out notes.
* Document trends from meetings and partner reports, and identify opportunities for systems improvement.
* Transcribe all Rapid Response Hotline calls, tracking and documenting trends and identifying opportunities for systems improvement. (SFRRN)

*Programmatic Coordination of SFILEN and SFRRN*

* Support program logistics and communications for both Networks, including email reminders and coordination of monthly calls, and meetings.
* Support logistics, coordination, and planning for annual programming. This includes Immigrant Family Day, International Migrants Day, budget advocacy, retreats, trainings, and other Network-wide events and activities.

*Content and Material Development*

* Create visuals, infographics, and digital media for SFILEN and SFRRN events, campaigns, programming, and meetings. Examples include fliers, one-pagers, advocacy and fundraising materials, toolkits, and communications content.

  

*Data and Research*

* Provide timely data from SFILEN and SFRRN’s work to respective Network staff, partners, and funders, and articulate and document analyses and impact of such data.
* Assist with the collection, and coordination of data retrieved from other related immigration networks, such as the California Coalition for Immigrant Justice (CCIJ), the San Francisco Immigrant Legal Defense Collaborative (SFILDC), and other partners including intakes, statistics, reports, and referrals to inform SFILEN and SFRRN’s work.
* Conduct and/or coordinate research projects on immigration trends, immigration policy changes, relevant community resources, and other subjects.

  

*Translation*

* Translate communications and notes between English and Spanish to ensure accessibility of information across Network partners.

  

*Rapid Response Network*

* Serve as a dispatcher on the Rapid Response Hotline, where back-up is needed. This includes answering hotline phone calls, triaging emergency immigration situations, completing intake forms, and communicating with various stakeholders to coordinate service referrals.
